B.finding: Official solves the indegree-sequence problem in O(N) with a direct direction-set DP. This corroborates that a scalable linear solution exists, but does not make the frozen implementation claim-grade because repeated max-style frozen O2 runs exceeded the 2-second limit.

C.finding: Official reverses time, canonicalizes pictures by alternating maximal simultaneous row/column coloring operations, and counts standard procedures with O(N^2) DP states and O(N) transitions, O(N^3) overall for N=max(H,W). Frozen full-state BFS is qualitatively non-scalable.

D.finding: Official reformulates each move as replacing a length-3 window by its maximum, defines exact-x feasibility P(x), checks P(x) greedily in O(N), proves the x->x-2 monotonicity beyond a boundary, and needs only P(m),P(m+1), giving O(N). Frozen multiset BFS is qualitatively non-scalable.
